column1: # Game profile of Well Dweller (Switch, base game 1.0.0). Plays on the Mac from the language list through the title screen, the intro credits, the
# story pages and into the first room with its dialog, at 60 fps, with sound (see README.md)
# GameMaker Studio 2: a native runner (main, 57.4 MB of text) whose game data is in the RomFS as game.win (FORM/GEN8, 229 MB) beside three
# audiogroup*.dat banks and an options.ini naming the LLVM-Switch target. It renders with NVIDIA's desktop OpenGL through EGL: main imports nine
# EGL functions and takes every GL call from eglGetProcAddress, which the host's GL layer answers on Metal (dm/gfx/gl/hle_gl.m, GL 3.2), so
# NVIDIA's GL driver (subsdk0) is never loaded. SDK 22.2.0
# The shaders are GLSL ES 1.00 that the runner writes at run time, one variant per pipeline, in no game file: the NSP script captures them by
# booting the game on the Mac (gl_capture.tsv lists all 93) and dm/gfx/tools/gl_shaders.py translates them offline; the host finds each by hash
# main imports the EGL functions only, so NVIDIA's GL driver (subsdk0, NintendoSDK_OpenGL) stays unloaded; subsdk1 is the movie player
# game.win is the runner's data file and .dat the audio banks; neither compresses
# nninitStartup asks for a heap of the pool less the used memory, 3.10 GB, mapped as it is touched
# the NPDM declares no system resource, so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on hardware
# no NVN shaders: the profile's NVN tables stay empty and the GL library comes from gl_shaders.py (gl_capture.tsv)
